world_news.headline: Zak Butters trade rumours dominate Port Adelaide's turbulent season
world_news.summary: Port Adelaide has grappled with a turbulent year, navigating the 2026 season with a newly-appointed coach and the poorly-kept secret that one of its key talents would seek a trade.

world_news.headline: Washington Post ordered to rehire columnist fired over Charlie Kirk posts
world_news.summary: Karen Attiah was fired for posts about Charlie Kirk’s assassination that the Post said violated its social media policy.

world_news.headline: Cyclists run for cover as hailstorm forces La Vuelta stage cancellation
world_news.summary: A torrential hailstorm in the French Pyrenees forced the abandonment of the third stage of the Vuelta a España on Monday.

world_news.headline: From almost drowning as a child to the pinnacle of surf lifesaving
world_news.summary: A childhood accident could so easily have cost surf lifesaver Tiarnee Massie her life. But now the 28-year-old heads into this year's Iron Series as the number one seed.

world_news.headline: Mexico’s president condemns governor’s brief return to office
world_news.summary: President Sheinbaum criticises Governor Rocha's return amid US drug charges, calling it 'reckless' and 'inappropriate'.

world_news.headline: Yemen’s Houthis report attack on Saudi ship
world_news.summary: Saudi shipping company Bahri confirmed its vessel was struck, all crew members safe.

world_news.headline: Video: Israel attacks desalination plant and mosque in Gaza
world_news.summary: Israel has attacked a critical water desalination plant and a mosque in Gaza as it intensifies attacks on the enclave.

world_news.headline: England drop fast bowler Carse after nightclub incident
world_news.summary: England fast bowler Brydon Carse has been dropped from the squad for the second Test against Pakistan following an investigation into an incident at a club in Derby.

world_news.headline: Israeli restrictions cause fuel shortage in occupied West Bank
world_news.summary: Israeli restrictions are disrupting fuel supplies across the occupied West Bank.

world_news.headline: Iran faces 'greatest financial offensive ever', says US treasury secretary
world_news.summary: Scott Bessent says the US will sever all economic ties with the country and that any nation partnering with Iran financially will also be isolated.
